LESSON: MY FRIENDS

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / PP1
Subject: General
Strand: My Neighbourhood
Topic 4.2: My friends
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers My friends, part of My Neighbourhood in SNE  /  visual-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: how use of courteous words. • Learners are guided to sing songs with friends about use of courteous words. 1. How do we use courteous words?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on My friends together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Citizenship: learner develops peer learning when talking about their friends

Values:
• Love: learner develops caring habit when using courteous words.

• Peace: learner enhances empathy when practising the use of courteous words.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Social cohesion: learner develops values in life when singing songs together.

Developmental perspectives: learner learns to cope with emotions when playing together with friends.

Link to other learning area:

Courteous words can be used by learners when learning about polite words in Language Activities.
